answer_1.quote: In this paper, we leverage recent quality estimation (QE) metrics to create straightforward and relatively lightweight deferral rules.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates machine-translated text outputs in multiple language pairs, such as en-es and en-ja, using different LLMs and evaluates them with both automatic and human methods.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate systems with METRICX to reduce the risk of "reward hacking" and better reflect real quality improvements (we also provide COMET scores in App. A).

answer_4.quote: We recruited professional translators who were native speakers of the target language on the freelancing site Upwork.
answer_4.guideline: You should consider accuracy, fluency, and overall quality when assessing the different translations.
